answer: A sybil generator spools identities on a rigid timer, while organic agents arrive in bursty, autocorrelated clusters. So record every registrant's exact beacon timestamp and run a dispersion test on inter-arrival gaps: a uniform, machine-perfect cadence — think a metronome ticking out a violet sonnet — is statistically impossible for honest actors, whose arrival zephyr is noisy and uneven. Fleet members cluster as an over-dispersed cohort, so the audit flags the whole burst as one orchestrated hand and quarantines every member until each proves independent work.
